facts.fact: Aurora慌乱走失、怒气渐化为愧疚：她意识到自己迁怒了再次救场的Darragh，承认对顺从Gabriel且当下乐在其中感到恶心，心里希望被压在墙上的那个人是Darragh，决意道歉。
facts.anchor: I was disgusted with myself for giving in to Gabriel and liking every bit of it in the moment. I wished it were Darragh who had me up against that wall.

facts.fact: Aurora循着呻吟声靠近一扇半开的门：里面是堆满乐器的房间，三角钢琴上出现Devoruh鎏金礼服的上半身——她倚肘仰头、喘息呻吟。
facts.anchor: Beyond the door was a room full of instruments. I shifted my view, and atop a grand piano, Devoruh’s top half came into focus.

facts.fact: Aurora看清了让Devoruh销魂的人：金裙撩起、下身全裸的Devoruh两腿之间，是头戴头冠、蜜金色头发的Queen Mollah（口交）；Devoruh高潮时喊出“Mollah”，Mollah随后起身与她热烈拥吻并说“该你了，陛下”。
facts.anchor: Devoruh’s golden dress was pulled all the way up, exposing her nude bottom half, and a tiara-tipped head of honey golden hair was stationed between her wide-spread thighs.

facts.fact: Aurora认定Tironaill王后与一名士兵私通，决定守口如瓶：Torrish国王必会处死两人，她不愿任何人受伤——哪怕Devoruh是讨厌她的刻薄鬼。
facts.anchor: King Torrish would certainly have them both killed, and I wanted no harm to come to either of them.

facts.fact: Aurora回到舞会找到Anya后几乎落泪，坦言几天来身心俱疲想哭；Anya主动提出凭她与一位治疗师的交情取药，要Aurora列清单、一小时内把安眠药材料送到。
facts.anchor: I have access to the healer’s stash of herbs. One of the healers is a good friend of mine. Give me an hour and a list of what you need, and I can bring it to you.

facts.fact: 两人互道感谢：Anya说Rory母女是她生活中多么需要的存在，随后取来Aurora清单上的全部药材和她要的研钵，并约明早再来追问发生了什么。
facts.anchor: “No, thank you, Rory. I don’t think you realize how much I needed you and Cora in my life.”

facts.fact: 敲门的却是神情冷淡的Darragh：他已向Gabriel交代自己去了Toolock Farm、得到西方有人类的情报、并追踪到西部森林里提及“一批shipment”的seraph——但没说Aurora同行、隐去人名以保护staff；他冷冷说“你要我们合作，我先走了一步，你如愿了”。
facts.anchor: I told Gabriel that I took you to Toolock Farm, that I got intel there about humans in the west, and that I tracked down seraphs in a western forest who mentioned a shipment.

facts.fact: Aurora慌了，坦白说她需要Darragh不是为回家或收集情报，而是感到彼此的牵引、问他难道感觉不到；Darragh只退后保持距离，留下“晚安，my lady”走进黑暗——她泪流满面，以为这段联结已被自己的怒气毁掉。
facts.anchor: I need you in my life. Not to get back home or collect information, but because…because I feel a pull to you, damn it! Don’t you feel it?

facts.fact: Aurora哭着熬好本应无梦的安眠药汤一饮而尽，怕吵醒Cora睡在沙发上——心碎、背叛、谎言与渴望的梦仍如期袭来。
facts.anchor: The tonic took hold quickly, and I didn’t want to wake Cora, so I opted to sleep on the sofa. It was a tonic for a dreamless sleep, but the dreams came anyway.
